outcome: Timing of total bile acid elevation
cohort: Pregnant women at the Beijing Youan Hospital in China between January 1, 2010 and November 31, 2016 (n=217)
finding: Pregnant women with both HBV and ICP experienced a higher rate of adverse pregnancy outcomes compared to those with only HBV, including preterm birth, cesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, and low birth weight.
